notes.note: Reviewed final terminal-status recovery handler and mounted regression: a signed expired/cancelled/revoked result closes the request and returns to fresh setup, while uncertain activation asks for status rather than cancellation. Reverting the committed wizard to d164 made the named terminal-status test fail for the missing Request device access action; restored source passes. Post-login diagnostics use allowlisted stage/code and omit raw failure text. Earlier expired challenge owner tests and native compilation evidence remain separate from installed-client acceptance, which is NOT_VERIFIED.
